usage: Verify a deal credential offline: read the kid from the token footer, select the matching key here, and verify the v4.public signature. The token's `bearer` claim names which party of the deal holds it (poster or negotiator); a token minted before that claim existed carries no bearer and proves deal membership only. A verifier MUST check the token's typ claim is exactly "cogdepot.deal.v1" and its deal_id is the deal being acted on: this key signs other cogDepot token types too, so a signature check alone accepts tokens that are not deal credentials.
